content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?Jana Kramer's PostJana Kramer Verified accountMarch 18 at 3:02 PM · Inspiring Story · SigmaMusicArt · Shared with Public#1 movie in the U.S. on Netflix today… and I’m honestly speechless. So grateful, and so emotional.But like I shared yesterday, this movie means so much more to me than a ranking. This was a deeply personal project to be part of. Through Morgan’s story, I found strength in my own journey with domestic violence. I’m incredibly thankful she was brave enough to share her truth, because in telling her story, I found healing in mine.And from the many messages you’ve sent me, I know it’s resonating in ways that matter far beyond a number.
